observations: Scaffold lint inherited the parent Git target/ exclusion and found no files. Scoped oxlint to src and vite.config.js with --no-ignore; fixture-placement issue, not rgit failure.

Unexpected refusal: after restoring an older file-shaped snapshot while the current change still points at a directory-shaped snapshot, restoring the latter reports checkout path has an unsafe parent. No overwrite occurred. Trial workaround: snapshot the restored baseline, then restore the nested snapshot and snapshot it before integration.

Second shape refusal: change new changes the tracking baseline without materializing files. Starting a file-based change while a saved directory-shaped change is on disk makes those nested files appear untracked; restore refuses. Preserved the carried files with a snapshot, restored main, and changed subsequent trial setup to restore the intended line before creating the new change.

Harness correction: the first untracked-collision probe used a path still tracked by the active change, so --discard-changes correctly allowed replacement (exit 0). Retried after creating a change whose saved baseline omits that path; only the corrected probe tests untracked protection.
